```{r}
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}
url <- "https://lvr.land.moi.gov.tw/SERVICE/QueryPrice/46ebd317af0bc30010d762db7673a295?"

headers <- c(
  `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36" #Example User-Agent
)



res <- GET(url, add_headers(headers)) %>% 
    content("text") %>%
    fromJSON()
```
